summary: The terminal UI requires stable foreground-visible thread bodies for automatic reading and offers private reminders with explicit clearing

replay.detail: The client uses the existing thread read and unread reminder actions; no replay policy changes.

schema.detail: No additional schema or generated client changes beyond the composed unread API dependency.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Requires negotiated threads-v1 version 3 and thread.read access; version 2 members use the existing upgrade-required state without querying reminder lists or anchors. No privacy, storage or writer version changes. Read-only connections hide mark actions and natural read history is preserved.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or startup work.

manual.detail: Mark read clears all observed private reminders even when their anchors are unavailable, without reading unseen history. Mark unread is available in Ctrl+K and the thread panel. Inbox lists private marked-unread threads. These features require threads-v1 version 3; older members show upgrade required.

recovery.detail: No new local persistent state. Reminders remain authoritative on the member across client restarts.
